name: hr-agent
description: HR Chat Agent: LangGraph.js agent (server/) + React UI (client/)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
